title: Adapt a legacy sensor to Thermometer

task.text: The system speaks `Thermometer`; the vendor driver speaks text.
`Thermometer` and `LegacySensor` (in `Legacy.java`, read-only) cannot change. Write the **adapter** `SensorThermometer(LegacySensor)` so that anything that needs a `Thermometer` can use the sensor.

items: `celsius()` polls the sensor once per call and returns degrees Celsius as an `OptionalDouble`.
`"C:21.5"` gives 21.5, `"F:212"` gives 100.0, and an empty reading gives `OptionalDouble.empty()`.
The adapter wraps the sensor; it does not extend it.

checks.title: An offline sensor gives an empty reading
The adapter holds the sensor, privately
The sensor's text format stays inside

hints.text: The caller wants one interface, the vendor offers another. Do the translation (text to a typed number, units, absence) in one place that implements the interface callers expect.
`SensorThermometer` implements `Thermometer` and keeps a `private final LegacySensor`. In `celsius()`, poll, split the text at the colon, and switch on the unit.
